info.title: BOM Validation and Anomaly Detection Prototype API
info.description: ORDS-generated REST API for the BOM (Bill of Materials) validation, anomaly detection, findings review, AI advisory, and diagnostics prototype. Exposed via Oracle REST Data Services (ORDS) under schema alias `bom`, module `bom_api`.

servers.description: ORDS base path for the bom_api module (schema alias: bom)

tags.name: BOMs
tags.description: BOM summary, detail, and refresh operations

tags.name: Findings
tags.description: Validation findings review and status management

tags.name: Advisories
tags.description: AI-generated advisory summaries for BOMs and findings

get.description: Returns aggregate KPIs: BOM counts by health status, average health score, open finding count, severity breakdown, and item-class summary.

post.description: Triggers an asynchronous refresh of dashboard metrics. Returns immediately with 202 Accepted.

get.description: Returns a paginated, filterable list of BOMs with component counts and open finding counts.

parameters.name: search_text
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match against item number or description.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Filter to BOMs having at least one open/reviewed finding of this severity.

get.description: Returns full BOM detail including header, components, and findings.

post.description: Creates a mock REFRESH run record for the given BOM.

get.description: Returns the run history for a specific BOM, most recent first.

post.summary: Generate AI advisory for a BOM
post.description: Generates a mock AI advisory summary scoped to the entire BOM.

get.description: Returns global run history across all BOMs, most recent first.

post.description: Invokes BOM_VALIDATION_PKG.run_full_validation for the given bom_id.

get.description: Returns validation findings across all BOMs, filterable by status, severity, and rule.

patch.description: Transitions a finding to OPEN, REVIEWED, or IGNORED, logs the review, and recalculates the parent BOM's health score.

400.description: Invalid status, missing comment, or update failed

post.summary: Generate AI advisory for a finding
post.description: Generates a mock AI advisory summary scoped to a single finding.

get.description: Returns diagnostic/event log entries, most recent first.

post.description: Creates a DBMS_SCHEDULER job that runs full validation against all BOMs on a daily or weekly cadence at the specified time.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM time of day to run the job.
